# Review edition for 26 October

Start with [Three-Essays-Review.pdf](Three-Essays-Review.pdf). It contains the review guide and the three recommended essays in order.

- [Review-Guide.pdf](Review-Guide.pdf): assessment, reading order, changes, reserves and unresolved issues.
- [Holistic-Accuracy.pdf](Holistic-Accuracy.pdf): A5 v2, the strongest candidate in this pass.
- [Free-Evidence.pdf](Free-Evidence.pdf): A6 v2, with corrected quantifiers and a continuous-model argument.
- [Flattening.pdf](Flattening.pdf): E3 v4, with a substantially more cautious interpretation claim.
- [Causation-Reserve.pdf](Causation-Reserve.pdf): A4 v2, with a repaired proof and narrower scope.

Editable versions are in [essays](essays). The full assessment is [REVIEW-GUIDE.md](REVIEW-GUIDE.md), with [methodology](METHODOLOGY.md), [verification](VALIDATION.md), [source requests](SOURCE-REQUESTS.md), and [revision differences](revision-diffs). The archive preserves the other nine developed tracks and the eight earlier exploratory drafts as received. Their presence is not a fresh endorsement.

This edition advances A5 and A6, with E3 as a provisional third for review. It does not certify that three novel discoveries have been established. No contest submission was made. Original drafts and historical disclosures remain unchanged in the repository.
